orbit-frames.purpose: unobstructed orbit of the loaded Smithsonian museum 3D scan after offline Gaussian conversion

import-frames.purpose: real Reality-panel import and local-bytes-ready receipt

calibration-frames.purpose: real A/B Gaussian LOD picks, markers, line, known-length entry, and apply

verification-frames.purpose: a second, distinct A/B width check using the calibrated Gaussian representation of the museum scan

spatial-read-frames.purpose: actual inspect_workspace_space result showing calibrated metric bounds

proxy-build-frames.purpose: Agent creates and links exact editable proxy geometry

proxy-edit-frames.purpose: publish the reusable model, prove proxy-owned atomic collision rejection, place the corrected instance, edit 8 mm to 10 mm, then Undo and Redo

export-frames.purpose: export the published protective-case model as USDA while excluding the Gaussian capture

reopen-frames.purpose: undo, redo, save, reopen, and same-browser local-vault recovery

final-frames.purpose: final Reality-plus-proxy composition and clean identity frame

claimBoundary.captureSource: a Smithsonian museum 3D scan supplied as GLB and converted offline into a supported Gaussian PLY before import; SemaFrame performs neither the GLB conversion nor reconstruction from photos or video
claimBoundary.measurement: the capture automation selects A and B through the same Inspector pointer controls available to a person, on Spark's current Gaussian LOD, then supplies one known real distance; this is a visual estimate, not survey or CAD measurement
claimBoundary.verification: the automated proof uses a second, distinct A/B session and a near-full-width visible pair in the live calibrated Gaussian representation; it compares that measured span with the catalog width but is not a blind or metrological validation
claimBoundary.agentVision: the deterministic authorized Agent run reads safe descriptor data, calibration, metric world bounds, and proxy relations; no model-autonomy claim and no claim that it receives raw splats, pixels, the source GLB, or automatically traces the scan
claimBoundary.engineeringAuthority: the Gaussian representation of the museum scan is visual evidence only; linked parametric proxies are the sole source of collision, physics, dimensions, and engineering meaning
claimBoundary.precision: SI parameters are exact for the proxy; alignment accuracy remains bounded by the source museum scan, offline conversion, coordinate declaration, known reference, and Gaussian LOD picks
claimBoundary.export: OpenUSD USDA contains the published parametric protective-case model only; it does not include the semantic proxy, Gaussian representation, source GLB, or the complete Workspace
claimBoundary.persistence: Workspace metadata and local asset-vault state survive same-browser reopen; another browser may require exact-digest relinking
claimBoundary.certification: no survey, professional mechanical CAD, FEA, structural certification, manufacturing tolerance, or general digital-twin certification claim

truthGatesBeforeRender: record the Smithsonian asset URL, identifier, license or usage terms, source GLB digest, conversion method, and converted PLY digest in evidence.json
use the actual offline-converted supported Gaussian PLY under 256 MiB and 4 million splats
record the museum scan's documented coordinate basis, known-height calibration, and distinct second-span width check
show local-bytes-ready and a non-placeholder orbit before making any spatial claim
use the real surface-pick result on the converted Gaussian representation; never draw fixed A/B points or lines over it, and never bake substitute measurement values into the composition
use one known span for scale and a different known span for verification
retain the permanent visual-only and not-survey-or-CAD boundary note
show inspect_workspace_space evidence before attributing metric-bounds reasoning to the Agent
link semanticProxyIds and prove collision against the proxy rather than the Gaussian
publish only a model-assembly and spatial-primitive subtree
run usdchecker on the newly exported USDA and record its output in evidence.json
verify undo, redo, save, and same-browser reopen using the actual final Workspace
run visual QA on both independent aspect-ratio editions and both posters
